method: Actual outer hull vertices of owned base LOD0 bottom surfaces at0.01cm tolerance; no invented AABB corner points. Upper-floor overhangs excluded. Floor-only foundation identity remains unverified. Landscape and explicitly tagged support triangles determine gaps; bounds only select candidates.
limitations: Export precedes S5 material/camera changes; final geometry binding unverified.
Known S3 swapped building cannot inherit the old footing geometry.
Outer hull includes actual base vertices only; concave inner corners and continuous edge support are not fully sampled.
Other ground/paving/support categories not exhaustively classified; over15cm is a candidate, not a confirmed unsupported building.
Outer hull measurements do not prove absence of holes along every exterior edge.
Static exported geometry does not evaluate shader displacement or opacity.
excluded_scope: Outside-wall City records, village buildings and Castle assemblies are not part of398 census; no full-map ground acceptance.
prior_attempts_retained: ground07_03_console.log: actual physical outer hull vertices
